PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?zoneName ?timeseriesId WHERE {
    ?zone rdf:type brick:Zone .
    ?zone brick:hasPart/brick:isLocationOf/brick:hasPoint ?setpoint .
    ?setpoint rdf:type/rdfs:subClassOf* brick:Air_Temperature_Setpoint .
    ?zone ref:hasExternalReference/ref:ifcName ?zoneName .
    ?setpoint ref:hasExternalReference/ref:hasTimeseriesId ?timeseriesId .
}

The results include zone IFC names (e.g., "B4:453253") and timeseries IDs (e.g., "TUC.245.76.R435"), satisfying the user's request. No further refinement is needed as the query is building-agnostic, uses only standard Brick relationships, and matches the required topology described in the question.
